notes.title: Beku releases on Steam Early Access
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=jMwdsKlOnWY;full][/previewyoutube]

Beku is a game where you’re challenged to overcome waves of enemies that have been set out before you by King Beku through his powers of sorcery. Why? Because he’s looking for a knight to prove themselves worthy of protecting him from an unknown threat. However, as you endure more challenges, you’ll discover more secrets.

With 4 playable characters, Beku looks to challenge you with its intense combat that pits waves of enemies and challenges against you. For those who want to challenge themselves, an Arena mode will allow for perfecting skills and testing how long you can perserve against the increasing odds against you.

This marks the first phase of Beku’s release, and with this Early Access phase we are excited to hear your feedback and comments about the game. We’ll be looking to improve over time as we work to create a build that will eventually be released at a V.1 edition. If you’ve got any feedback and concerns, you can email beku@houndpicked.com, alternatively you start up a discussion here on Steam!

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy Beku!
